title: Fieldstone Golf Club
specs: Award-winning 18-hole par-71 golf course designed by Michael Hurdzan and Dana Fry
Course features multiple tee boxes, dramatic elevation changes, and scenic views
Recognized as one of Golf Inc.'s Most Admired Private Clubs

Appropriate golf attire required; unacceptable attire includes tank tops, halter tops, tee shirts, fishnet tops, cut-offs, jams, sweat pants, denim jeans, bathing suits, gym shorts, tennis shorts, short shorts or athletic shorts more than four inches above the knee
Private event spaces available including Board Room, Private Dining Room, and Champions Room for meetings, parties, and bridal showers
includes: Locker room facilities including lockers, shoe shining, snacks and beverages
gap: Price for green fees or guest play not stated
blurb: Fieldstone Golf Club offers an 18-hole, par-71 golf course designed by Michael Hurdzan and Dana Fry with multiple tee boxes and dramatic elevation changes. The club provides locker room facilities, golf carts with specific rules, and enforces a dress code for golf and dining areas. The clubhouse includes dining options and private event spaces for meetings and celebrations.
extraNote: All rounds begin off #1 tee unless directed otherwise · Golf cart rules: no hitching rides, certain holes are cart path only, keep carts out of rough except to enter fairway, maintain distance from putting surfaces · Pace of play: 18 holes should be completed by a foursome in 4 hours 10 minutes or less · Clubhouse and indoor facilities are non-smoking; smoking allowed on patio · Staff and management enforce policies; guests should observe dress code and etiquette · Bag drop area upon arrival
